By ANY Means


Child Rebel Soldier (@SpaceCat_28th)

No get them into trades THROUGH A UNION



— https://nitter.net/SpaceCat_28th/status/2043848497389076988#m

Gotta Cheer for a Georgian!!!


Inspirenaire (@Inspirenaire)

I don't watch Tennis the sport itself but I do watch great players.  Alycia Parks and her family are from Georgia.  Her father a former basketball player was key in getting her started.  At 26 She's 6'1 and her serves have been clocked at 128MPH. 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽 Impressive.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Inspirenaire/status/2043627783960547645#m

Black Mom's and Dad's get your kids into trades asap.


Anttsinc (@anttsinc)

Lowe’s is offering $250 million in grants to help those who want to learn the trades, electrician, carpenter, etc.

Home Depot lets you watch free videos to learn and get certified through them. This is actually paying you to go to school and learn the trades!

If you can’t find work, this is a great opportunity to get into the trades in Texas and electrician makes $250,000 a year

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/an

We wanna thank the lord too! Amen


Nia Long (@NiaLong)

Thank you @Playboy for capturing this moment of joy ❤️





— https://nitter.net/NiaLong/status/2043812939468288458#m

Toys R Us.  Easy


🦋💙𝓗𝓮𝓪𝓽𝓱𝓮𝓻💙🦋 (@bamagirl_4_eva)

Which one would you bring back?





— https://nitter.net/bamagirl_4_eva/status/2043403781019251011#m

Asè and Amen.  I appreciate seeing my friend/brother/potna appreciated.  He is truly a leader


Chris Bender (@cbenderatl)

Our Black entertainers give back so much to their communities and Atlanta. I wish "other" entertainers, corporate C-levels, and sports stars did the same.





— https://nitter.net/cbenderatl/status/2043494926814494903#m

My mom asked me if i wanted to go.  I slick hated.  Lame AF for not going but fuck it. 🤦🏽‍♂️


Everything Georgia (@GAFollowers)

On April 13, 1988, Michael Jackson brought 'The Bad Tour' to Atlanta, Georgia. 

The profits from the 3 concerts over the weekend went to the "Make A Wish" foundation for terminally ill children.





— https://nitter.net/GAFollowers/status/2043674313857912904#m

#GoHawks


Polymarket Hoops (@PolymarketHoops)

🚨HAWKS WILL OFFICIALLY PLAY THE KNICKS IN THE FIRST ROUND  

WHO WINS?





— https://nitter.net/PolymarketHoops/status/2043489379583455345#m

God bless them


Amunet (@freakoutsideofx)

Jadakiss with his wife❤️They have been together for 32 YEARS, raised twin boys and kept their relationship private.





— https://nitter.net/freakoutsideofx/status/2043484732449517725#m

#GoHawks


Legion Hoops (@LegionHoops)

The Knicks and Hawks will face off in the first round of playoffs.

Call it now: who you got, and in how many games? 🔥







— https://nitter.net/LegionHoops/status/2043490369711776008#m

#GoBraves


Michael Henshaw (@DarthHenshaw)

60 years ago today, the oldest continuously running sporting club in the United States made Atlanta its home.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/DarthHenshaw/status/2043502025267109919#m

Ice Cold!  Bring'em back!


FB_Helmet_Guy (@FB_Helmet_Guy)

Braves 80s powder blue uniforms.





— https://nitter.net/FB_Helmet_Guy/status/2043491217980133845#m

Thank the lord.  #GoBraves


Atlanta Braves (@Braves)

60 years ago today, the Braves arrived in Atlanta ⚾️

@BravesHistorian tells the story of how it happened: piped.video/CoGvyUKaA8o?si=yrOJ…





— https://nitter.net/Braves/status/2043461583624384895#m

Atlanta deserves this attitude from our guys.  This city is looking to support the hell outta players that wanna be here! Salutes CJ


Legion Hoops (@LegionHoops)

CJ McCollum on his message to the Hawks when he got traded there:

“I’ve lived a great life and made a lot of money,  and I just wanna see you guys be successful. Your success is my success, I’m not trying to keep moving my family so let’s figure out how to win.”

(via @OldManAndThree)





— https://nitter.net/LegionHoops/status/2043

Damn Right


Leslie Mines (@LeslieMinesIII)

Dale Murphy belongs in the Hall of Fame.



— https://nitter.net/LeslieMinesIII/status/2042750750871146796#m

These and the 80's baby blues are soOOO classic


Dalton (@daltine_cracker)

If Nike wasn't a trash uniform partner and MLB didn't hate fun, the Braves could break these unis out and have a full on 80s weekend this weekend





— https://nitter.net/daltine_cracker/status/2042736875891282266#m

@theswagshopedgewood has always been about more than cuts — it’s about community. Atlanta helped us establish roots, and now we’re honoring those same values as we grow. Big love to @Square for being part of the journey. #ad

I woke up with ‘Mania on my Mind. This beat is so cold I had to kill it. Don’t trip Cody, minor setback for a major comeback and congrats to Jey for getting his first World Title! Inspired By Old Atlanta & TBS! #wrestling #codyrhodes #jeyuso #rap #atlanta
Had to get bro right before his show in the A tomorrow @Tommy Richman
Super rare throwback #netflix #comedy #triggerwarning
To laugh at another man’s fault is to make their same mistake yourself..#addiction #killamike #runthejewels
Outside w the legends! #wwe
Out here #wwe
Shoutout my boy stacks! #andre3000 #scientistsandengineers #grammy #rap
